## Stage 2 — the opt-in wire-fidelity members (commit `19652a00`)

`model_port` slot params (arm-time decode, strict unknown-member/
value refusals, serialized only when non-default):

- `transport ∈ {stream, non_stream}` — `non_stream` asks
  `application/json`; the response decodes through the **existing**
  `completion_frames` decoder (no second decoder — CC1). REQ-XE-107.
- `stream_member ∈ {send, omit}` — `omit` removes the `stream` member
  (mini's recorded shape); `stream`+`omit` refuses typed (a streaming
  lane that never declares `stream` contradicts itself).
- `tool_choice ∈ {auto, omit}` — `omit` removes `tool_choice`
  (REQ-XE-106 contributing). `stream_options` is inserted only when
  `transport: stream` (a non-stream lane gets none).
- `transcript_render{…}` (REQ-XE-108): `assistant_replay.content |
  .reasoning ∈ {drop, verbatim}`, `assistant_replay.extra_members[]`,
  `text_only_turn ∈ {drop, replay}`, `format_error_turn ∈ {kernel_note,
  omit}`, `id_normalisation ∈ {kernel, provider_verbatim}`,
  `tool_arguments ∈ {canonical, verbatim}`.

The replayed bytes fold from the durable `hh.model_io/1` blob the
completed row's `response_ref` names — a new `LedgerSink::blob_read`
seam (implemented on `KernelSink`, default `None` = seam-less sinks)
carried into `ModelPort::requested_members` (X-04 — no second
response-byte store; an unresolvable/unparseable ref or a recorded
call-count/provider-id mismatch is `malformed_history`, never a
fabrication). `ChunkTranslator` now translates `reasoning_content` into
the shared `reasoning_delta` frame vocabulary and preserves
message-level extra members on `stream_end.data.message_extra` — the
blob is the verbatim source for `reasoning`/`extra_members` replay.
`format_error_turn: omit` drops the offending assistant turn *and* its
kernel note (the note leg now also covers `control.output.rejected` /
`action.tool.call.refused` rows). `transcript_render` declarations are
admitted under the chat-completions family only — Messages-family
declarations refuse typed, never a silently different replay.

## Tests (all new, would fail without the plumbing)

`crates/hh-embed/tests/r6_34.rs` — 6 tests:

- `ac3_non_stream_golden_and_decode` — loopback fake provider serves a
  plain `chat.completion`; the declared `non_stream`+`omit` body has no
  `stream`/`stream_options`/`tool_choice` members (pinned by the
  committed golden `tests/fixtures/r6_34/ac3_nonstream_request.json`),
  and BM18's recorded body decodes through `decode_exchange_frames` →
  `grammar::decode_frame` to one completed call with provider id and
  `reasoning_content` intact.
- `ac3_stream_member_omit_under_stream_refuses` — the contradictory
  declaration refuses typed.
- `ac4_bm_replay_goldens` — BM18 + BM4–BM10 rendered under the declared
  replay; committed golden `tests/fixtures/r6_34/ac4_replay_goldens.json`.
- `ac4_spaced_arguments_and_provider_ids_byte_exact` —
  `{"command": "ls -la"}` round-trips byte-exact under
  `tool_arguments: verbatim` (the row's canonical `args_raw` differs);
  the blob lookup is recorded (replay reads the durable blob), and
  `call_9` renders in both `tool_calls[].id` and `tool_call_id`.
- `ac4_unresolved_blob_refuses_typed` — declared replay against an
  unresolvable `response_ref` answers `plan_error`, never fabricates.
- `ac5_undeclared_renders_byte_identically` — an all-absent lane equals
  an explicit-defaults lane, keeps `stream:true`/`stream_options`, and
  performs **zero** blob reads (the hit counter is empty).

Golden `provenance: hand_derived` on both fixture files (REQ-XE-114 —
until the O-recorded corpus lands they are never evidence).

## Deviations

- `requested_members` gains a blob-seam parameter (the X-04 channel —
  driver passes `sink.blob_read`); the two legacy test call sites gained
  the `&|_: &str| None` default. Documented, additive trait-member
  change with a default body — all `ModelPort` implementations keep the
  default or were updated (only `GatewayModel` implements it).
- `transcript_render` is admitted under the chat-completions family only
  for this stage — the member spellings are chat-completions-shaped;
  Messages-family replay stays an open member set for a later record.
